notes: Table 2 names no test; its significance marks are read as PR CIs excluding 1. Table 1 Wald chi-square p-values are given per level (level vs rest), so groupwise entries are per-group vs referent only. Estimates with RSE >30% are flagged, not suppressed.
view_issues: Text says MBDD prevalence was higher at each lower income level vs ≥400% FPL, but 200%–399% PR 1.2 (0.9–1.5) is not significant. Table 1 note defines 'parent lacks emotional support' by a 'no' answer; Table 2 note says 'yes'.
